name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Kids' Pack Vol. 1
summary:
Kids' Pack Vol. 1 contains 4 songs: "ANPANMAN'S MARCH", "Anpanman Exercise", "Courage, Ringing" and "UKIUKI OTOPPE".

This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode, Great Drum Toy War and Run! Ninja Dojo. The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.
